8.3 File Storage
This section lists all functions and classes that are required to operate a
File Stor-
age
.
The following functions are used to get access to a
File Storage
, to recover as
much as possible after it was corrupted, to reset it to the deployed defaults, and to get
the amount of storage space allocated to the
File Storage
. In addition, operators
are present to combine the
ara::per::OpenMode
values passed as
mode
to the
OpenFile
*
functions.
